accepted_budgets.other_limits: Carry every stricter per-turn/per-game/storage partition from the frozen original registration and accepted amendments unchanged; debit before dispatch/call.

data_roles: Reuse existing training data read-only. Old validation and previous development remain known screens, never fresh independent evidence or gradient data.
Keep the fixed independent numerical full-group sampling rule. Do not choose groups after seeing errors or replace over-budget groups.

Register a fresh ten-seed official panel before scoring using the same declared generator/exclusion rule, excluding all earlier registered, failed and unused reserved game seeds. First two are development; last eight stay untouched until development passes. Do not choose seeds by results.
Retain all gates, bootstrap rules and stop rules. Never reuse old test outcomes to tune or lower thresholds.
family_stop: No coefficient, direction, temperature, LR, steps, mixture, initialization, interpolation or checkpoint rescue after a scientific failure. The new game inventory is fixed for novelty before results, not selected for improvement.
implementation_scope: Use a new source namespace and output directory; connect only necessary registration, worker and campaign adapters to the frozen repaired launcher.

Keep spawn creation/start/serialization/IPC/control outside artifact guards, parent receipts cumulatively bounded and real-worker artifact writers guarded. Do not call the unchanged globally guarded old launcher.
Preserve feature/candidate/controller/statistics/official-replay behavior by frozen identity. Review concrete adapter differences and changed behavior; no repository-wide audit.
Freeze sources, data/source identities, counters and seed roles. Independent source review and an exact-byte local preregistration commit must pass before the one real fit.

new_game_seed_rule.selection: Same frozen first-eligible exclusion rule, newly inventory all previous registered/failed/reserved values before any scoring

numerical_and_economic_gates: One fit only. Count failed/in-flight work and apply the fixed process/artifact limits.
Require numeric integrity, zero CPU/GPU first-argmax differences and unchanged CE ratio gates: known development at most 0.95 and original validation at most 1.02.
Only after that gate run 24 preregistered development games; only if their gates pass run 96 holdout games. A reached-stage failure closes the stage without replacement.

Independently verify reached numeric/game/replay evidence. Root judges S improvement, teacher retention and changed control separately. Fit success is not policy improvement and never automatically changes the default Bot.
reason: The fixed anchor treatment never reached its worker. The demonstrated infrastructure blocker is repaired. Authorize one separately budgeted execution of that unchanged scientific treatment, not adaptive parameter search.
stop_rule: Any entry, storage, immutability, cleanup, numeric, development or holdout failure closes the new stage with actual consumption. No retry/refund, second fit or silent extension. A materially different future learning question needs separate root adjudication.

treatment.frozen_components: Existing architecture, normalizer, crop head, masks, candidate ordering and controller mechanisms; only the already specified task treatment trains.
treatment.initialization: Original S checkpoint and fresh optimizer; never the failed DAgger candidate.
treatment.loss: Weighted CE over 256 complete groups plus 1.0 times weighted KL(p_S || p_C) over old 128 groups; temperature 1; frozen S stop_gradient.
treatment.no_search: No coefficient/direction/temperature/LR/step/mix/init/checkpoint/threshold changes, interpolation, model selection, PPO or action-space expansion.
